changelog:
Initial release – track your Product Hunt launch stats in real-time from the CLI.

- View live post stats: rank, upvotes, and comments.
- Monitor your launch progress with a live dashboard.
- List the current day's Product Hunt leaderboard.
- Requires Product Hunt API token for authentication.
summary: Track your Product Hunt launch stats (Rank, Upvotes, Comments) in real-time via CLI.
